## Comprehensive Hit/Combat VFX Systems Analysis

### 1. Hit Detection Flow (End-to-End)

The hit pipeline flows through these steps:

**A) Player Input → Swing Initiation** (`WrenchSwingController.cs`)
- File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingController.cs`
- Left mouse down begins charge via `PowerBuildupManager.Instance.BeginCharge(ActionType.Swing)`
- Mouse up calls `DoSwing(bool quickSwing)` which:
  - Reads `_aimer.HoveredGameObject` (the target under cursor)
  - Calls `_playerInit.EmitHit(_aimer.WorldAimPoint, target, damage)` — the legacy path (uses `PlayerHitInfo`)
  - Updates `WrenchSwingArc.Play(_aimer.WorldAimPoint)` for the swing arc visual
  - Publishes `ToolSwingStarted` event on `GameEventBus`

**B) Legacy Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.cs`, `ResourceManager.cs`, `ResourceNode.cs`)
- `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit(Vector3 point, GameObject target, int power)` raises hit via `ResourceManager.Instance.RaiseHit(new PlayerHitInfo(...))`
- `ResourceManager` re-broadcasts via `OnResourceHit` event
- Each active `ResourceNode` checks `IsThisResource(target)` and calls `ReceiveHit(damage)` if matched

**C) New Tool Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.EmitToolHit`, `ResourceNode.TryApplyToolHit`)
- `EmitToolHit(ToolHitContext hit)` publishes `ToolHitTarget` event (for feedback/audio) and falls back to legacy path
- `ResourceNode.TryApplyToolHit(ToolHitContext)` looks up tool effectiveness via `ToolEffectivenessTable`, applies `effectiveness * damage`, publishes `ResourceHit` + `ResourceDamaged` on `GameEventBus`

**D) Thrown Wrench** (`ThrownWrench.cs`)
- File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ThrownWrench.cs`
- Uses `OnCollisionEnter(Collision)` — finds `ResourceNode` via `GetComponentInParent<ResourceNode>()`
- Constructs a `ToolHitContext` with `ToolActionType.Throw` and calls `node.TryApplyToolHit(hit)`

args.result:
## Comprehensive Hit/Combat VFX Systems Analysis

### 1. Hit Detection Flow (End-to-End)

The hit pipeline flows through these steps:

**A) Player Input → Swing Initiation** (`WrenchSwingController.cs`)
- File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingController.cs`
- Left mouse down begins charge via `PowerBuildupManager.Instance.BeginCharge(ActionType.Swing)`
- Mouse up calls `DoSwing(bool quickSwing)` which:
  - Reads `_aimer.HoveredGameObject` (the target under cursor)
  - Calls `_playerInit.EmitHit(_aimer.WorldAimPoint, target, damage)` — the legacy path (uses `PlayerHitInfo`)
  - Updates `WrenchSwingArc.Play(_aimer.WorldAimPoint)` for the swing arc visual
  - Publishes `ToolSwingStarted` event on `GameEventBus`

**B) Legacy Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.cs`, `ResourceManager.cs`, `ResourceNode.cs`)
- `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit(Vector3 point, GameObject target, int power)` raises hit via `ResourceManager.Instance.RaiseHit(new PlayerHitInfo(...))`
- `ResourceManager` re-broadcasts via `OnResourceHit` event
- Each active `ResourceNode` checks `IsThisResource(target)` and calls `ReceiveHit(damage)` if matched

**C) New Tool Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.EmitToolHit`, `ResourceNode.TryApplyToolHit`)
- `EmitToolHit(ToolHitContext hit)` publishes `ToolHitTarget` event (for feedback/audio) and falls back to legacy path
- `ResourceNode.TryApplyToolHit(ToolHitContext)` looks up tool effectiveness via `ToolEffectivenessTable`, applies `effectiveness * damage`, publishes `ResourceHit` + `ResourceDamaged` on `GameEventBus`

**D) Thrown Wrench** (`ThrownWrench.cs`)
- File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ThrownWrench.cs`
- Uses `OnCollisionEnter(Collision)` — finds `ResourceNode` via `GetComponentInParent<ResourceNode>()`
- Constructs a `ToolHitContext` with `ToolActionType.Throw` and calls `node.TryApplyToolHit(hit)`
- Uses physics collision detection (no overlap/sphere check)

### 2. VFX / Particle Systems Status — VERY EARLY / PLACEHOLDER

**No VFX prefabs exist.** Searching for `Hit*.prefab`, `Impact*.prefab`, `*Particle*.prefab`, `*VFX*.prefab`, `*Effect*.prefab`, `*FX*.prefab` in all of `Assets/` returned zero results. There is no `Assets/Flynn/Effects/` directory.

**The only visual feedback that exists:**

A) **WrenchSwingArc** (placeholder) — `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingArc.cs`
- Runtime-created `LineRenderer` slash from player → hit point (yellow-tinted, fades out)
- Runtime-created `LineRenderer` ring at the hit endpoint (expanding circle, fades out)
- Uses `Sprites/Default` shader — no particles or textures
- Comments explicitly say: *"Placeholder wrench swing VFX: a slash line... Will be swapped for real sprite anims later."*

B) **ResourceDeathFall** — `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ResourceDeathFall.cs`
- When a `ResourceNode` is depleted: disables colliders, disables `Billboard`, topples the sprite over ~0.7s with fade out. No particles.

C) **ResourceShake** — `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ResourceShake.cs`
- Positional shake on the resource node's transform when hit (sine-wave wobble, 0.18s duration). Scales with damage dealt.

D) **FeedbackManager** — `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Managers/FeedbackManager.cs`
- Subscribes to 8 event types on `GameEventBus` but **only logs Debug.Log messages**. No VFX instantiation.
- Comments: *"logs debug messages for now. Actual VFX instantiation will be added later."*

E) **FeedbackProfile** — `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Feedback/FeedbackProfile.cs`
- ScriptableObject with string IDs for VFX prefabs (hitEffectPrefabId, breakEffectPrefabId, impactEffectPrefabId, etc.)
- Has placeholder camera shake fields: `cameraShakeIntensity = 0.1f`, `cameraShakeDuration = 0.2f`
- Comments: *"Defines the structure with string IDs. Prefab references will be added when actual VFX assets are available."*

### 3. "Hittable" / Resource Systems — NO generic IHittable/IDamageable

**No `IHittable`, `IHit`, `Damageable`, or `HealthComponent` interfaces/classes exist** anywhere in the project.

**Instead the project uses specific concrete classes:**

- **`ResourceNode`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ResourceNode.cs`) — The only damage receiver. Has runtime health (`CurrentHealth`/`MaxHealth`), damage events, depletion flow. Requires `ResourceNodeConfig` ScriptableObject.
- **`ResourceNodeConfig`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ResourceNodeConfig.cs`) — Defines `requiredTool`, `maxHealth`, `resourceType`, `drops[]`, `echoShardChancePerHit`.
- **`HittableSurface`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/HittableSurface.cs`) — NOT a damage receiver. Only maps `SurfaceMaterial` (Wood/Metal/Rock) to `AttackAnimIndex` (1=Pitch, 2=Axe, 3=Hammer, 4=Wrench). Used solely for tool swap animation on non-resource props.
- **`ToolEffectivenessTable`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ToolEffectivenessTable.cs`) — Maps `(ToolType, ResourceType) → multiplier`. Wrench gets 0.3 default (can harvest anything inefficiently). Other unmatched tools get 0.

**Resource Types:** `Stone`, `Wood`, `TechTrash`, `None`, `Unknown`
**Tool Types:** `Pick (1)`, `Axe (2)`, `Hammer (3)`, `Wrench (4)`
**Tool Action Types:** `Swing (0)`, `Throw (1)`

### 4. WrenchSwingArc — Full Details

File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingArc.cs`
- Requires `LineRenderer` component (the slash line).
- At runtime creates a child GameObject "Ring" with a second `LineRenderer`.
- `Play(Vector3 worldAimPoint)` starts the animation.
- **Slash**: Draws from `transform.position + Vector3.up * 0.8f` to aim point over 0.1s, then fades over 0.15s. Color `(1, 0.9, 0.6, fade)` yellow.
- **Ring**: Starts after 0.05s delay, expands from 0.05 → 0.5 radius over 0.1s, fades over 0.2s. Color `(1, 0.7, 0.3, fade)` orange.
- Uses `Sprites/Default` material (no VFX shader).

### 5. PlayerMouseAimer — Hit Detection Details

File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/PlayerMouseAimer.cs`
- **`HoveredGameObject`** property delegates to `MousePointer.Instance.HoverObject` — the single shared raycast result.
- **`MousePointer`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/MousePointer.cs`) does ONE `Physics.Raycast` per frame against a combined `_worldMask` layer mask.
- Melee range: `_meleeRange = 2.5f` (configurable)
- Interaction range: `_interactionRange = 3f` (configurable)
- Max aim distance: `_maxAimDistance = 30f`
- `SwingAnimIndex` defaults to 4 (air/wrench). Changes to 1/2/3 if a `ResourceNode` or `HittableSurface` is hovered within melee range.
- `MeleeResource` is set if a `ResourceNode` is within melee range (used for damage application)

### 6. Screen Shake, Hit Stop, Camera Effects — NOT IMPLEMENTED

- **`FeedbackProfile.cameraShakeIntensity`** (0.1) and **`cameraShakeDuration`** (0.2) exist as data fields only — no code reads or applies them.
- **`ResourceShake`** is *positional* shake on the resource node transform, not camera shake.
- **No hit stop / hit pause / time freeze** code exists anywhere.
- **No camera effects** (cinemachine impulse, screen flash, post-processing) are implemented.
- `FeedbackManager.OnBatteryEmpty()` logs "Screen flash" but does nothing.

### 7. Layer Setup and Colliders

**From `ProjectSettings/TagManager.asset`:**
| Layer | Name |
|-------|------|
| 0 | Default |
| 1 | TransparentFX |
| 2 | Ignore Raycast |
| 3 | (empty) |
| 4 | Water |
| 5 | UI |
| 6 | (empty) |
| 7 | (empty) |
| 8 | Grappleable |
| 9 | Pickup |
| 10 | WaterInteraction |

**Important: Layers 3, 6, 7 are unassigned.**

**Tags:** Only one custom tag: "Ground"

**Colliders in scene:**
- Resource prefabs (Tree, Stone, MetalScrap) use **BoxCollider** on Layer 0 (Default)
- `ThrownWrench.prefab` also uses Layer 0
- `Tree_Light.prefab` uses Layer 0
- The `MousePointer` uses a single combined `_worldMask` for all raycasting — no per-system masks

### Summary of What Exists vs What's Missing

**Exists (code structures in place):**
- Full hit detection pipeline (input → aim → swing → damage)
- Tool effectiveness lookup table
- Power charge/release system with damage scaling
- Event bus architecture (8 event types for resource/tool feedback)
- FeedbackManager skeleton (subscribes, logs)
- FeedbackProfile data asset
- WrenchSwingArc placeholder (LineRenderer-based)
- ResourceShake (positional nudge)
- ResourceDeathFall (topple + fade)

**Missing (nothing implemented):**
- ❌ No particle system prefabs or VFX assets of any kind
- ❌ No `Effects/` folder
- ❌ No camera shake code (fields exist but unused)
- ❌ No hit stop / time freeze

- DO NOT use this tool for file operations like reading, writing, editing, or searching files. Prefer the dedicated file tools for those actions.

If the tool reports a "Full output saved to: <path>", that file contains the full command output. - File: `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingController.cs`

- Mouse up calls `DoSwing(bool quickSwing)` which:
  - Reads `_aimer.HoveredGameObject` (the target under cursor)
  - Calls `_playerInit.EmitHit(_aimer.WorldAimPoint, target, damage)` — the legacy path (uses `PlayerHitInfo`)
  - Updates `WrenchSwingArc.Play(_aimer.WorldAimPoint)` for the swing arc visual
  - Publishes `ToolSwingStarted` event on `GameEventBus`

**B) Legacy Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.cs`, `ResourceManager.cs`, `ResourceNode.cs`)
- `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit(Vector3 point, GameObject target, int power)` raises hit via `ResourceManager.Instance.RaiseHit(new PlayerHitInfo(...))`
- `ResourceManager` re-broadcasts via `OnResourceHit` event
- Each active `ResourceNode` checks `IsThisResource(target)` and calls `ReceiveHit(damage)` if matched

**C) New Tool Hit Path** (`PlayerInitializer.EmitToolHit`, `ResourceNode.TryApplyToolHit`)
